This is how I pay all my bills in one place 🙌 I used to juggle 5 different apps every month just to pay my bills, until I found out @setel actually lets you pay everything in just one app. Way less stress, way less time wasted. This is how I pay all of my bills in one place. I used to pay every Bill in different apps and I genuinely thought that was just normal until I found a way to do all of this in one place. Let me show you. So settle just released a new feature where you can actually pay all of your bills in just one place. No more opening 5 different apps and remembering 5 different passwords every single month. Now with one app, everything can settle. To do this, you open the settle app and go to Bill Payment. From there, you can see all the listed billers. So you can just pick the biller of your choice, key in your account number, punch in the amount you wanna pay, then just pay with your settle wallet or your credit or debit card and you're basically done. So you pay hundred ringgit in bills, you can get 10 ringgit straight back. You're literally getting paid to pay your bills and that cashback goes right back into your daily spendings like your groceries, your coffee runs, whatever you want. You're already spending the money anyway, so at least get something back Lah. And on top of the cashback, you also collect merchant reward points every single time you pay. These aren't the useless kind They just sit there doing nothing. When you redeem them, they turn straight into settle credit, basically free money on top of your cashback. So yeah, instead of juggling 5 different apps every single month to pay your bills, now you can pay all of them in just one place, done in 2 minutes, and it actually pays you back. So yeah, check out the settle app today and start paying all of your bills in one place. Chow Peace.
